title: Machine Learning Engineer II
overview:

Your future team

At DevInfra Transformations, we enable teams to ship quality at velocity. Our focus is to “Build an industry-leading internal platform. Validate our hypothesis with data. Ship features for internal and external usage”. This is accomplished by building complete end-to-end ML enabled development cycle and leveraging AI capabilities extensively. This is a unique opportunity to work in a collaborative environment, implement the cutting edge machine learning techniques, especially forecasting modelings, and tackle challenging and distinctive problems.
responsibilities:
• As a Machine Learning engineer -2, you will work on the development and implementation of the cutting edge machine learning algorithms, training sophisticated models, collaborating with engineering and analytics teams, to build the AI functionality into Atlassian products and platforms.

  • Your daily responsibilities will encompass a broad spectrum of tasks such as designing system and model features, conducting rigorous experimentation and model evaluations, and providing guidance to junior ML engineers.

  • Your role is pivotal, stretching beyond these tasks, ensuring AI's transformative potential is realized across Atlassian.

Your background

  • 5+ years of related industry experience in the data science domain

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree (preferably a Computer Science degree or equivalent experience)

  • Expertise in Python or Java with and the ability to write performant production-quality code, familiarity with SQL, knowledge of Spark and cloud data environments (e.g. AWS, Databricks)

  • Experience building and scaling machine learning models in business applications using large amounts of data

  • Ability to communicate and explain data science concepts to diverse audiences, craft a compelling story

  • Focus on business practicality and the 80/20 rule; very high bar for output quality, but recognize the business benefit of "having something now" vs "perfection sometime in the future"

  • Agile development mindset, appreciating the benefit of constant iteration and improvement

  • Experience in developing deep learning-based models and working on LLM-related applications

  • • Excelling in solving ambiguous and complex problems, being able to navigate through uncertain situations, breaking down complex challenges into manageable components and developing innovative solutions

title: Principal Data Platform Engineer
overview:
Are you passionate about data platforms and tools? Are you an open-minded, structured thinker who is passionate about building systems at scale. Do you understand data platforms, know how to build them and want to help our users to make data actionable? If so, this role with our team at Atlassian is for you.
We are looking for a Principal Software Engineer to join our Data Platform Team to build a world class data platform that powers crucial business decisions throughout the organization.
You will partner with analytics teams, data engineers and data scientists across various initiatives and work with them to understand the gaps and bring your findings back to the team to build these capabilities.

Working at Atlassian

Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.
responsibilities:
We build analytical data platforms for Atlassian that serve both Engineering and Data Engineering to help them generate valuable insights from data.

As a Principal Engineer on this team you will:

  • Own the long term architecture and technical direction for core platform capabilities and be accountable for their reliability, cost efficiency and adoption

  • Design and build foundational platform components that other engineering teams build on top of, across areas like ingestion, transformation, orchestration, compute and consumption

  • Architect robust multi-tenant platform standards by establishing clear cross-layer contracts, tenant isolation, and SLOs to enable autonomous producers and consumers, while driving compute and storage efficiency across workloads

  • Lead cross team technical initiatives and architecture reviews, influence platform strategy with senior stakeholders and act as a technical mentor and multiplier for Senior engineers

  • Stay hands on. You will be in the code on the hardest problems, not just reviewing designs
qualifications:
Required

  • 12+ years of software or data engineering experience, with at least 6 years building data platform infrastructure

  • You have built a data platform or a significant component of one and operated it in production. For example an ingestion framework, a transformation framework, a compute or query layer, an orchestration layer, a metadata or lineage service or a data quality framework

  • You can describe the scale that component ran at in concrete numbers. Data volume, ingest throughput, number of pipelines or jobs, query concurrency and latency, number of onboarded teams or tenants and infrastructure cost.

  • Deep understanding of big data and distributed systems challenges including partitioning, shuffle behaviour, skew, idempotency and backfills

  • Experience designing both batch and streaming architectures and clear judgement on when each is the right answer

  • Expert level programming skills in language such as Java, Kotlin or Python and built solutions on public cloud offerings such as Amazon Web Services

  • Experience with big data processing and storage technologies such as Spark, DBT and with open table formats such as Iceberg or Delta Lake

  • A track record of owning ambiguous cross team problems end to end and of influencing without authority

  • Degree in Computer Science, EE or a related STEM discipline or equivalent practical experience

Nice to have

  • Experience with high performance analytical or MPP databases such as StarRocks, Druid, ClickHouse or Pinot

  • Experience with change data capture and event driven ingestion at high volume

  • Experience building a semantic layer or metrics store and governing shared metric definitions

  • Experience with the data foundations of ML platforms, such as point-in-time correct training data, online and offline feature parity or backfilling features at scale

  • Experience with data governance, access control, lineage and compliance, including regulated environments such as FedRAMP

  • Experience running platform components on Kubernetes

  • Experience with multi region data architectures, including replication, failover and consistency tradeoffs

title: Principal Engineer, Search Platform

responsibilities:
As a Principal Engineer in Search Platform, you will serve as a technical leader driving the core indexing engines and enterprise-grade trust capabilities that power Atlassian Search and Rovo.

You will lead the technical vision, architecture and delivery for planetary-scale data ingestion and indexing platforms while ensuring Search meets strict enterprise commitments across multi-cloud (GCP/AWS), isolated cloud, compliance, and encryption.

Responsibilities

  • Lead Enterprise Trust & Compliance: Own technical strategy and delivery for enterprise requirements - multi-cloud (GCP/AWS), Isolated Cloud, FedRAMP, BYOK encryption, and data residency - making Search a platform enterprises can trust. Proactively simplifying architecture and removing

  • Shape the Indexing Platform for AI-era Workloads: Evolve high-throughput, low-latency distributed indexing pipelines to meet the retrieval demands of agentic and AI use cases - freshness, context relevance, and scale across billions of events.

  • Connect Across Teams and Systems: Work fluidly across ML, Data, Cloud Infrastructure, and product teams - aligning technical direction, unblocking dependencies, and building shared platform capabilities that multiply the impact of teams beyond your own. Help improve support for building and operating systems that deliver true Enterprise Trust through Atlassian-wide platforms, while actively simplifying the architecture and eliminating accumulated complexity.

  • Drive System Efficiency at Scale: Improve ingestion throughput, data freshness, and reliability while optimizing for unit economics through smarter sharding, disaggregated storage, and compute efficiency.

  • Capitalize on Agentic Development Advances: Stay ahead of the curve on retrieval architectures, vector/hybrid indexing, and agentic memory patterns - bringing external advances in to accelerate Atlassian's platform and product roadmap.

  • Enterprise Platform Experience: 12+ years of demonstrated experience delivering enterprise-grade requirements - tenant isolation, multi-cloud deployments, compliance frameworks (FedRAMP, BYOK, data residency), and zero-downtime migrations at scale.

  • Distributed Systems Depth: Proven experience designing and operating large-scale distributed data pipelines, search/indexing systems, or streaming platforms (e.g., Kafka, Flink, OpenSearch/Elasticsearch, object-store-backed indexing, vector search).
